**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Route the size preflight through the limiter**

For every capped image pull, this inspect container receives only `HOME`; sharing the proxy's Docker network does not set `HTTPS_PROXY`, so Skopeo connects directly to the registry outside the token bucket. This also makes the preflight fail silently on proxy-only hosts, returning an unknown size and disabling both the staging-capacity check and determinate progress. Configure this container to use the already-running limiter proxy just like the copy container.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve trust for registries using a private CA**

When a secure private registry uses a CA installed under the Docker daemon's certificate configuration, it does not appear in `InsecureRegistryCIDRs`, so this still selects the isolated Skopeo path even though that container lacks the daemon's CA. Fresh evidence after the earlier trust fix is that the current implementation consults only `InsecureRegistryCIDRs`; capped pulls from privately certified registries therefore fail TLS verification while ordinary daemon pulls succeed.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Establish TLS when chaining through an HTTPS proxy**

When `HTTPS_PROXY` names a TLS-protected proxy such as `https://proxy.example:443`, this parser discards the scheme and `connect_target` sends a plaintext CONNECT request over a raw socket. Fresh evidence after the earlier proxy-chaining fix is that no TLS wrapping occurs after the scheme is removed, so capped pulls fail against HTTPS proxy endpoints even though the host's normal proxy-aware clients work.
